basics.name: Carlos Ruiz Torres
basics.label: Data Engineer at Ryanair
basics.summary: Data Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable ELT pipelines, lakehouse architectures, and cloud-native data solutions. Currently at Ryanair, leading analytics engineering and AI integration into data workflows. Passionate about data quality, semantic layers, and cutting repetitive work with AI-driven processes.

work.name: Ryanair
highlights: Build and maintain ELT pipelines (Apache Airflow, dbt) and scalable data models in Databricks lakehouse, leveraging PySpark, Spark SQL, and Python for optimized query performance.
Led analytics engineering end-to-end — semantic layer design, data contract implementation, and cross-functional alignment — improving data reliability and accelerating time-to-insight.
Architect AWS solutions and own the full deployment lifecycle through IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation) and automated CI/CD pipelines via AWS CodePipeline.
Spearheaded AI integration into engineering and data analytics workflows, enabling the team to cut repetitive task time by over 60% through scalable, reusable AI-driven processes.
Collaborated closely with data scientists to improve the performance of the dynamic pricing model for products by over 50%.

work.name: NEXT DIGITAL HUB
highlights: Developed and optimized end-to-end ELT processes using AWS Cloud (S3, Redshift, RDS, Lambda, AWS Batch on Fargate).
Implemented Data Mesh Architecture to enhance data accessibility and collaboration, significantly improving cross-team operational efficiency.
Built efficient Python-based data processing pipelines to enhance data quality and system performance.
Automated complex workflows using Apache Airflow to reduce manual intervention.

work.name: StratioBD
highlights: Performed and managed ETL processes using the Stratio Data Centric product and end-to-end batch workflows with Apache Spark, PostgreSQL, and Apache Kafka, handling high-volume real-time data streams.
Designed and created interactive Metabase dashboards to provide actionable business insights for stakeholders.
Ensured Data Governance best practices through rigorous data quality controls and metadata management.
Managed projects with Jira applying Scrum methodology to ensure timely delivery of data products.
